household.title: Rushwork fish trap with continuous circular twinned strip woven around the canes. [MJD 09/06/2009]

Decorated basket with a bulbous base, tapering into a cylindrical neck. The lid is fixed to the basket. The bulbous section is decorated with a zig zag pattern, the cylindrical neck is undecorated, the top of the lid is decorated with a star. [BH [OPS Move] 6/12/2016]

Rectangular basket with lid attached. Flat bottom basket with straight sides, and slightly inset neck and rounded rim. The two shorter sides are decorated with a chequerboard pattern. One of the longer sides is decorated with eight animal profiles, and the other with a wide zig-zag pattern with dark points. The lid, which fits over the inset neck of the basket, is flat topped with slightly rounded sides, and is attached to the basket by means of a short plaited cord on the interior of both the lid and the basket. It is decorated with a repeating lozenge pattern on the top.  [MOBB [OPS move] 1/12/2016]
Baskety tray, coiled with 'v' shaped design in brown plant fibre. [MJD 10/6/2010]
Carved wooden headrest with curved top . [SM (Verve) 11/02/2014]

Wooden spoon with plain handle and leaf shaped spoon bowl with incised designs. The end of the handle has been darkened, possibly by burning. The exterior of the bowl of the spoon is decorated with three diamonds in a line. The area around the diamonds has also been darkened. [MOBB [OPS move] 23/5/2016]

Wooden spoon with stained decoration. The end of the handle has been darkened, possibly using heat. Just below this a piece of metal wire has been wrapped around twice. The exterior of the bowl which has four incised triangles which have been darkened, possibly through the same technique. [MOBB [OPS move] 23/5/2016]

Wooden spoon with rectangular handle top. This spoon is of a light coloured wood with a flat bowl which attaches to the handle at almost ninety degrees. The exterior and interior of the rectangular loop at the end of the handle have been burnt to create a darker colour, as has the rim of the bowl. The exterior of the bowl and some of the lower part of the handle is decorated with burnt dots and a hatchet shape. [MOBB [OPS move] 19/5/2016]

Wooden spoon with handle top carved to represent crested bird. The body and crest of the bird are darkened. The body is further decorated with spots where circles have been carved out; the neck has dark ovals created, possibly using pyro-engraving. The exterior of the spoon has two diamonds connected by a line, all outlined with incised lines and made dark. [MOBB [OPS move] 23/5/2016]

Large ladle carved from single piece of wood, with channel extending into the handle. It is decorated with carved decorations some of which are darkened, possibly through burning or pyro-engraving. [MOBB [OPS move] 25/5/2016]
Wooden bladed adze.  The adze blade is painted black.  The handle has a black end and black carved painted lines. The blade is socketed into the handle. [MJD (Verve) 11/05/2015]
Basket-work, short cylindrical base and stem joined to disc of larger diameter, with black decorative design. [BH [OPS Move] 5/12/2016]

Cylindrical basketry container that tapers into domed base. patches of leather sewn into the basketry, with leather tassels. The dome is also made from leather that has been plaited. [BH [OPS Move] 5/12/2016]

Coiled basketry lid. Flat top with rounded sides. This lid slides into the basket, and so there are short, straight sides within the lid for this purpose. The lid is decorated with a five petalled flower with a dark centre (which is the centre of the basketry coil). The flower is in 'negative', that is the space around it has been stained darker, leaving the petals the lighter colour of the weaving material. The basket for this lid is [1935.56.29 .1]. [MOBB [OPS move] 1/12/2016]
Oval basket with lid fixed to the basket. Woven designs in dark brown plant fibre. [BH [OPS Move] 5/12/2016]
Conical shapes unfinished rush basket. [CW [OPS Move] 12/12/2016]

Wooden spoon with handle top carved to represent a tusked animal. The coat of the animal is decorated with oval shaped spots created by carving sections of the darkened wood to reveal the original wood below. The tusks have been darkened to delineate them. [MOBB [OPS move] 23/5/2016]
Circular basketry bowl on a shallow pedestal. The bowl is patterned with concentric bands of triangles dyed black. [CW [OPS Move] 19/12/2016]

Coiled basket. Flat bottom with shallow expanding lower section, then narrowing from lower shoulder to the bottom of the neck. The neck has a smaller diameter at the bottom than that of the body, and continues to narrow to an unembellished rim. The body is decorated with sections of three horizontal zig-zag lines which are 'negative' in that the spaces around and between them have been stained darker than the rest of the material. The lid for this basket is [1935.56.29 .2]. [MOBB [OPS move] 1/12/2016]
Baskety tray, coiled with 'v' shaped design in brown plant fibre. [MJD 10/6/2010]
Globular shaped coiled basket with attached lid. The basket is patterned with triangles and zigzags dyed black. [CW [OPS Move] 19/12/2016]

Tongs for pipe lighting. Made from metal. Bound near the tips with a sliding metal strip, the tips are flattened. The tongs have two metal rings attached at the bent junction. [AB [OPS Move] 23/6/2017]

Wooden spoon with plain handle and leaf shaped spoon bowl with incised designs. The end of the handle and the underside of the bowl have been decorated using pyroengraving techniques. The handle also is wrapped in metal wire. [MOBB [OPS move] 19/5/2016]

Carved wood spoon of light wood. It has a shallow bowl which is almost perpendicular to the handle. The end of the handle curves backwards in the opposite direction of the bowl. The rim of the bowl, the top edge of the end of the handle are burnt to create dark lines. The underside of the bowl and part of the handle are decorated with semi-circular shapes also made with pyroengraving. [MOBB [OPS move] 19/5/2016]
Wooden spoon with blackened pattern on the exterior of the leaf shaped bowl, and the end of the handle carved and blackened to represent an animal face. [MOBB [OPS move] 23/5/2016]

Wooden spoon with decorated handle top representing animal head, possibly a ram. The ears of the animal have had circles carved out imitating spots. The exterior rim of the leaf or oval shaped bowl has been darkened, as has a line down the centre and a narrow oval section to one side of the centre line. [MOBB [OPS move] 23/5/2016]

Wooden spoon with handle top carved to represent crested bird. The body of the bird and its crest have been darkened, and the spots on the body have been created by carving our circles. The rim of the bowl of the spoon has also been darkened, as has a line down the centre of the exterior of the spoon. [MOBB [OPS move] 23/5/2016]

Oval wooden dish. Dark wood with a rounded base. Open-work triangles carved along the flat rim which overhangs on the exterior sides. Carved marks appear on the inside of the bowl. [RM [OPS move] 15/9/2016]

Oval wooden box - "makeke" - used for cooked food or meal

Lamellaphone with 8 vibrating iron tongues. Backrest carved from one piece with the board, fan shaped board.  Bar and bridge of iron, bar tied down over tongues with wire in 10 places 2 of these at the sides.  Bridge is a flat piece of iron.  There is a small loop of iron bar attached on the base of the board with 4 rattling pieces.  The board is carved on the outside with grooved lines at on the base with 4 patterns.  The gourd resonator has a textile padding stitched on around the rim.  [HLR]

Leg rattles made out of seed pods of varying sizes. These are tied together on cord, with coloured fabric at either end.  [CW 24 9 1997] 
Made of strychnos seed pods. The seeds are mounted on string on six bands of 4,5,5,5,5,6 pods on each band. A thick band of string top and bottom is bound with maroon and red fabric, the seeds are perforated with holes in cross or oval shapes.    [HLR]
